name: Toggle switch
what: A switch pops in off and flips on - the knob slides with a squash, the track turns green and glows, the word under it changes; it can flip on, off and on again.

learned_from.what: OFF to ON: the knob slides, the track turns green, the glow grows
the toggle beside a label (a still capture)

motion: in back.out 12 f; a flip 10 f (S-curve), the knob stretches 1.28 mid-way, the colour and glow follow; 30 f between flips
